subject: Combining domain satisfaction measures into overall satisfaction

messages.author: b9eb1d0b4ead9830
messages.subject: Combining domain satisfaction measures into overall satisfaction
parts:
Hi, I am trying to combine several measures of individuals' satisfaction on their finance, health, work, etc into one overall life satisfaction/ happiness. People with high overall happiness tend to give positive answers on their finance, work,... satisfaction questions, so the causal relation is from the latent to the measures. But at the same time, events happen in life influence both overall happiness and the measures.
Could i use CFA with effect indicators to estimate the overall happiness scores or what is the best way to combine those items? 

Thanks a lot!
